Class PomHandler

java.lang.Object
org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler
org.owasp.dependencycheck.xml.pom.PomHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContentHandler, DTDHandler, EntityResolver, ErrorHandler

A handler to read the pom.xml model.
